Example Game Core Rules
Last Updated: 2000-01-01

100. Playing
101.         Setup
102.         Each player shuffles their deck and draws 5 cards.
102.1.                A player may redraw once.
103.         The first player is chosen randomly.
200. Winning
201.         Points
202.         A player wins when they reach 10 points.
202.1.                Players cannot have less than 0 points.
                      This continuation line belongs to rule 202.1.
203.         A player who cannot draw loses 1 point instead.
